pages.title: Psionic Resonator
pages.text: The $(item)Psionic Resonator$() amplifies and crystallises thought itself.$(br2)$(thing)Tier 3$() machine.
I must be honest in my own notebook: there is no known physics of psionics. Thought, as far as anyone knows, is electrochemistry in neurons. Yet the resonator works. I record; I do not yet explain.
$(thing)Made on the Extreme Assembly Table$() (it is also a crafting table). The recipe pages at the end of this entry - and JEI - show the pattern.
$(thing)Machine data$(): a single-block machine (4 item and 2 fluid inputs, 1 and 0 outputs).$(br2)$(thing)Makes$(): Boltzmann Brain, Psionic Crystal, Thought Matrix.
